subject: MAP: Legal redlines — ownership & turnaround commitments (post-demo)
message_1_subject: Post-demo recap: MAP draft + legal milestone owners
message_1_body:
Hi Daniel / Sophie,

Thanks again for the demo today — great conversation. Per our ask, attached is the latest Mutual Action Plan (MAP) v0.3 with the milestone rows filled out from Redwood's side. Two items we want to lock down this week: legal ownership on contract redlines (MSA/DPA/SLA) and target turnaround times so the timeline to production doesn't slip.

Summary of the ask (actionable):
- Redwood: will take the first-pass on MSA and DPA comments for items that are Redwood-standard (security, data residency, indemnity ceilings). Turnaround: 3 business days after you confirm point of contact.
- Acme: please confirm who on your side will own the first redline pass for commercial points / procurement clauses. Suggested TAT: 5 business days.
- SLA items: we propose Priya N. (cc) to own the SLA matrix conversation and produce an updated SLA matrix for your legal to review. Turnaround: 4 business days.

Attachments: MAP_acme_v0.3.pdf (MAP with milestones), acme_legal_redlines_initial.docx (placeholder for your comments), dds_sla_matrix.xlsx (initial Redwood SLA matrix).

Target close date on the MAP is 2026-12-22 (customer requested) — that assumes both sides stick to the TATs above. If either party needs longer windows, please call that out and we will re-weight milestones.

Next steps we recommend this week:
1) Daniel / Sophie: confirm legal owner(s) and whether Acme will consolidate redlines into a single tracked doc or exchange via DocuSign for signature-ready changes.
2) Redwood: Jonas will circulate Redwood's initial MSA/DPA redline bundle within 3 business days after you confirm contacts.
3) Priya: will own SLA alignment and post the updated SLA matrix to the MAP folder.

Thanks — Vivek
--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Account Exec, Redwood Inference
attachments: [MAP_acme_v0.3.pdf (application/pdf), acme_legal_redlines_initial.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document), dds_sla_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
message_2_subject: Re: Post-demo recap: MAP draft + legal milestone owners
message_2_body:
Vivek — thanks for the clear note and the MAP.

Confirming: Sophie Lim (cc) will own Acme's legal redlines; she'll consolidate our commercial and procurement comments into a single tracked Word and return it to Redwood. We can commit to a 5-business-day turnaround on the initial redline set (target to you by 2026-12-09). If there are material commercial asks (discount/credit), I will loop Procurement and Finance and call out as exceptions.

We prefer to exchange tracked redlines first; once terms are agreed in-track, we can switch to DocuSign for signature.

A quick note on dependencies: our internal security review may request a short SOC2/Audit confirmation. Sophie — can you confirm whether Acme needs any additional evidence beyond the SOC2 link we already have?

message_3_subject: Re: Post-demo recap: MAP draft + legal milestone owners
message_3_body:
Thanks Daniel — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Redwood's side so expectations are aligned: 

• Redwood will produce an initial redline bundle for MSA/DPA that focuses on standard Redwood language (data handling, limited indemnity, liability cap aligned with ARR band). We’ll flag any commercial asks that look like exceptions.
• Proposed Redwood TAT: 3 business days for the first-pass redline bundle after Sophie confirms the right Acme POC and shares the format.
• Priya will own the SLA matrix work and will send a filled SLA spreadsheet (dds_sla_matrix.xlsx) for your review within 4 business days.
• Escalation/exception path: if Acme returns redlines that materially change pricing/SLAs (e.g., extended retention, custom SLAs), we’ll mark those as "exceptions" in the MAP and sync on a short exec touchpoint — proposed cadence: ad-hoc call within 48 hours.

Please confirm the preferred file exchange method (single tracked doc vs. separate MSA/DPA files). If single tracked doc, Jonas to upload Redwood's tracked changes into the Acme doc.

Target close date still 2026-12-22 unless either side requests an extension.

message_4_subject: Re: MAP legal owners and TAT — confirmed
message_4_body:
Daniel / Sophie — confirming the plan below and attaching the SLA matrix for your team to review.

What Redwood will deliver this week (deliverables & owners):
- Redwood MSA/DPA first-pass (Jonas): 3 business days from today; will upload tracked changes into the shared Drive folder.
- SLA matrix (Priya): attached dds_sla_matrix.xlsx with our standard SLOs, measurement windows, and remedies.
- Exceptions: any commercial exceptions flagged by Acme will be added to the MAP exceptions row with proposed owner and escalation timeline.

Sophie — once you drop Acme's tracked redlines we will triage and classify items into: Accept / Editorial / Exception (needs escalation). For exceptions, we will propose a short decision window (48–72 hrs) so we can keep the target close date.

Attachment stub: dds_sla_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet) — uploaded to MAP folder.

Link to the MAP + documents: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxx-MAP-Acme
